sourceNote: Verified recurring public-health observances from WHO and the United Nations. No local venues, organizers or registration links are invented.

campaigns.title: World Neglected Tropical Diseases Day
campaigns.description: Raises awareness of neglected tropical diseases and the need for prevention, treatment and care.

campaigns.title: World TB Day
campaigns.description: Highlights progress against tuberculosis and the need for early testing and treatment.

campaigns.title: World Health Day
campaigns.description: WHO's annual global health awareness day, marked every year on 7 April.

campaigns.title: World Chagas Disease Day
campaigns.description: Raises awareness of Chagas disease, which can affect the heart and digestive system.

campaigns.title: World Malaria Day
campaigns.description: Highlights malaria prevention, diagnosis and treatment.

campaigns.title: World Immunization Week
campaigns.description: Promotes vaccination across the life course and the value of protecting communities.

campaigns.title: World Hand Hygiene Day
campaigns.description: Promotes hand hygiene in health care to prevent infection and protect patients and staff.

campaigns.title: World No Tobacco Day
campaigns.description: Highlights the health risks of tobacco and the benefits of quitting.

campaigns.title: World Food Safety Day
campaigns.description: Highlights safe food handling and the prevention of foodborne disease.

campaigns.title: World Blood Donor Day
campaigns.description: Thanks blood donors and encourages safe, regular blood donation.

campaigns.title: International Day of Yoga
campaigns.description: Highlights the health benefits of yoga and regular physical activity.

campaigns.title: World Drowning Prevention Day
campaigns.description: Highlights drowning prevention, water safety and rescue skills.

campaigns.title: World Hepatitis Day
campaigns.description: Raises awareness of viral hepatitis and access to testing and treatment.

campaigns.title: World Breastfeeding Week
campaigns.description: Promotes breastfeeding support, protection and good nutrition for mothers and babies.

campaigns.title: World Suicide Prevention Day
campaigns.description: Encourages action to prevent suicide and support mental health.

campaigns.title: World Patient Safety Day
campaigns.description: Focuses on safer care and reducing avoidable harm in health services.

campaigns.title: World Rabies Day
campaigns.description: Highlights rabies prevention, dog vaccination and timely post-exposure care.

campaigns.title: International Day of Older Persons
campaigns.description: Highlights the health, dignity and inclusion of older people.

campaigns.title: World Mental Health Day
campaigns.description: Raises awareness of mental health and access to care.

campaigns.title: International Lead Poisoning Prevention Week
campaigns.description: Highlights the health risks of lead exposure, especially in children.

campaigns.title: World Diabetes Day
campaigns.description: Highlights diabetes prevention, diagnosis and ongoing care.

campaigns.title: World Prematurity Day
campaigns.description: Highlights the needs of babies born too soon and their families.

campaigns.title: World Cervical Cancer Elimination Day
campaigns.description: Supports HPV vaccination, screening and treatment to eliminate cervical cancer.

campaigns.title: World AMR Awareness Week
campaigns.description: Promotes careful use of antimicrobials to slow the spread of resistance.

campaigns.title: 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence
campaigns.description: Calls for action to end gender-based violence, which affects health and safety.

campaigns.title: World AIDS Day
campaigns.description: Highlights HIV prevention, testing, treatment and support.

campaigns.title: International Day of Persons with Disabilities
campaigns.description: Promotes the rights, well-being and inclusion of persons with disabilities.

campaigns.title: Universal Health Coverage Day
campaigns.description: Calls for affordable, quality health care for everyone, everywhere.
